mapper.select: SELECT order_item_no, order_no, product_option_no, quantity, unit_price, coupon_discount_amount, item_name, item_size, item_color FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT order_item_no as orderItemNo, order_no as orderNo, product_option_no as productOptionNo, item_name as itemName, item_size as itemSize, item_color as itemColor, quantity, unit_price as unitPrice, coupon_discount_amount as couponDiscountAmount, order_item_status as orderItemStatus FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT oi.product_option_no AS productOptionNo, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.item_name AS itemName, oi.item_size AS itemSize, oi.item_color AS itemColor, CASE WHEN img.image_url IS NOT NULL THEN '/upload/' || img.image_url ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl FROM order_item oi JOIN product_option po ON oi.product_option_no = po.product_option_no JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_no, image_url FROM ( SELECT pi.product_no, pi.image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.product_no ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.image_type = 'THUMB' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(pi.sort_order, 9999) ) AS rn FROM product_img pi ) WHERE rn = 1 ) img ON p.product_no = img.product_no WHERE oi.order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY oi.order_item_no ASC
select product_option_no from order_item where order_item_no = #{orderItemNo}
mapper.update: update product_option set stock = stock - #{quantity} where product_option_no = #{productOptionNo}
mapper.select: select UNIT_PRICE from order_item where order_item_no = #{orderItemNo}
select COUPON_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT from order_item where order_item_no = #{orderItemNo}
